issues.extracted: taxes (unlabeled) 561,183 (computed remainder = Debt Service column Taxes)
issues.on_page: p3 Property taxes 2,200,410 = General property 1,344,622 + Motor vehicle 130,916 + Occupation 163,689 (p13) + 561,183 exactly; no Debt Service schedule in the trimmed or full PDF
issues.issue: The remainder is arithmetically right and correctly marked. It falls entirely within the Statement of Activities 'Property taxes' line, but that line also holds motor vehicle and occupation taxes, so its label doesn't prove the tax type. Leaving it unlabeled is the conservative reading and is defensible.
